points.label: Creation setting
points.left: Speech, breath, heavens, and gathered waters are compressed into a brief act of praise.
points.right: Before light, land, creatures, or humanity appear, the scene already contains God, heavens and earth, darkness, the deep, waters, and Spirit.

points.label: Parties, action, or promise
points.left: Word and breath · Speaking · making · gathering · Heavens · waters · Creation summarized in praise
points.right: God creates · God’s Spirit over the waters · Heavens · earth · deep · waters · Created world · not yet ordered

payload.posture: Psalm 33 compresses creation into divine word, breath, gathered waters, and immediate obedience.
payload.tension: The psalm’s summary selects speech and breath from a narrative whose opening also retains darkness, deep, and unformed earth.
payload.title: Creation praised by word and breath / the opening narrated
